# Scientific owner authorization: EL-F13 feasibility

Date: 2026-09-05. Decision: `SCI-FRUIT-EL-F13-SCAN-AGREEMENT-FEASIBILITY-R0.1`.

The owner approved the concrete EL-F13 proposal with:

> I approve.  Let's give this a go

This authorizes the exact proposal at commit
`9b75104dd6df1708fe28f7de2178fcb2f85cf3c5`, whose
[manifest](EL_F13_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_R0.1.md) has SHA-256
`64e92d2e19322e7d6ee219d97d4ced984cd7036a45ada62442a9744cc993bf77`.
The four proposal members and their original proposal status remain unchanged
as the record of what was approved. This authorization supplies execution status.

The approved work is an isolated analysis helper, its fixed construction tests,
registration before scoring, six retained H/uninjected boundary evaluations,
and a complete report. The design fixes inputs, probes, references, numerical
and coverage conditions, and the one-thread, two-hour, 4 GiB RSS and 4 GiB
new-output limits. There are zero Citlali runs, interventions, new observations,
Unity operations or qualification access. Routine implementation defects may
be repaired within these limits without a new scientific decision. Changes to
method, inputs, scope, gates or resources require owner review.

The historical recurrence remains mandatory; EL-F12 remains negative. Any
future intervention or independent-pointing experiment requires its own
concrete owner decision. This feasibility approval does not begin Stage B.
